title: Proving metric shifts: Turning warnings into concrete numbers
text: Wrong. So, build twice, once as it is, then again with the reviewer's fix. Two things to verify. Pass one records what breaks. Pass two applies the rename and measures from there. And the patch is scoped by lineage, not by name. Transactions has its own amount cents column and a find and replace would have corrupted a second metric. Now, the second run, everything compiles, nothing is red, and monthly recurring revenue reads 1/100 of what it read before. The warning is a number now, not a hunch. Three layers, each earning its place. The deterministic layer proves structure. The language model reads intent. The simulation measures damage.
